dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: Nam, my colleague told me about Mae Nak. Who was she?
dialogue.reading: ˈnɑːm, maɪ ˈkɑːliːɡ ˈtoʊld miː əˈbaʊt ˈmeɪ ˈnɑːk. ˈhuː wʌz ʃiː?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: She's the most famous ghost in Thai legend. Apparently, she lived in Phra Khanong, near your apartment!
dialogue.reading: ʃiːz ðə ˈmoʊst ˈfeɪməs ˈɡoʊst ɪn ˈtaɪ ˈlɛdʒənd. əˈpærəntli, ʃiː ˈlɪvd ɪn ˈprɑː kəˈnɔːŋ, ˈnɪr jʊr əˈpɑːrtmənt!

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Her husband had to go away for a long time, and she passed away while he was gone.
dialogue.reading: hɜːr ˈhʌzbənd ˈhæd tə ˈɡoʊ əˈweɪ fər ə ˈlɔːŋ ˈtaɪm, ənd ʃiː ˈpæst əˈweɪ waɪl hiː wʌz ˈɡɔːn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: But when he came home, she was waiting for him at the house.
dialogue.reading: bʌt wɛn hiː ˈkeɪm ˈhoʊm, ʃiː wʌz ˈweɪtɪŋ fər hɪm ət ðə ˈhaʊs.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: As a ghost? That's creepy! Didn't he notice?
dialogue.reading: əz ə ˈɡoʊst? ðæts ˈkriːpi! ˈdɪdənt hiː ˈnoʊtɪs?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Obviously, he didn't know. He was so happy to see her again.
dialogue.reading: ˈɑːbviəsli, hiː ˈdɪdənt ˈnoʊ. hiː wʌz ˈsoʊ ˈhæpi tə ˈsiː hɜːr əˈɡɛn.

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: So how did he learn the truth?
dialogue.reading: soʊ ˈhaʊ dɪd hiː ˈlɜːrn ðə ˈtruːθ?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Apparently, she dropped a lime under the house and made her arm very long to pick it up!
dialogue.reading: əˈpærəntli, ʃiː ˈdrɑːpt ə ˈlaɪm ˈʌndər ðə ˈhaʊs ənd ˈmeɪd hɜːr ˈɑːrm ˈvɛri ˈlɔːŋ tə ˈpɪk ɪt ˈʌp!

dialogue.speaker: c
dialogue.text: What a great folk tale! I want to visit her shrine.
dialogue.reading: ˈwʌt ə ˈɡreɪt ˈfoʊk ˌteɪl! aɪ ˈwɑːnt tə ˈvɪzɪt hɜːr ˈʃraɪn.

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.text: Let's go on Friday evening. Hopefully, she won't follow you home!
dialogue.reading: lɛts ˈɡoʊ ɑːn ˈfraɪdeɪ ˈiːvnɪŋ. ˈhoʊpfəli, ʃiː ˈwoʊnt ˈfɑːloʊ juː ˈhoʊm!
